parole.significato: a cavan; a unit of dry capacity approximately equivalent to 2.3 US bushels
parole.testo: From Tagalog kaban. Also from Cebuano kaban. See also Japanese 鞄(かばん) (kaban, “bag”), Hokkien 合萬 /合万 (kap-bān, “cashbox; till”), Teochew 合萬 /合万 (kap buāng, “safebox”), Cantonese 夾萬 /夹万 (gaap³ maan⁶, “safebox”).

parole.significato: cogon grass; kunai grass, Imperata cylindrica
parole.testo: Borrowed from Tagalog kugon and Cebuano kugon.

parole.significato: coconut wine made from sweet coconut sap
parole.testo: Derived from Tagalog tuba or Cebuano tuba.
